lines.say: In 1184, a floor dropped a royal meeting into shit.
The eighteen year old king had packed the room to settle one feud.
The wooden beams under all those fancy asses were rotten.
The floor gave way, smashed through the one below, straight into the cesspit.
About sixty nobles died. A bunch got crushed, and others suffocated in human shit.
The king? He was perched in a stone window nook, waiting on a damn ladder.
caps: Perched in a stone window nook,

lines.say: One of the feuding guys fell in and got dragged out alive. The king left without settling shit.
caps: fell in, got dragged out alive.
